title: Request for Certification on the Nature of the Faculty Trustee Position
text:
November 12, 2026 
 
 
JULIUS GABINETE, DM  
President, Northern Bukidnon State College Faculty Association, Inc. (NBSCFAI) 
Faculty Trustee, NBSC Board of Trustees  
This College 
 
 
Re: Request for Certification on the Nature of the Faculty Trustee Position 
 
Dear Dr. Gabinete: 
 
Greetings! 
 
This refers to your letter dated November 11, 2026, requesting a formal statement 
on the nature, manner of selection, and legal basis of the position of Faculty 
Trustee. You intend to submit it as supplementary documentation for your 
application for faculty reclassification under DBM-CHED Joint Circular No. 1, s. 
2026. 
After review, this Office confirms the following: 
1. Under Section 6 of Republic Act No. 11284, the Charter of Northern 
Bukidnon State College, in relation to Section 3 of Republic Act No. 8292 
and Sections 6(g), 7, and 11 of CHED Memorandum Order No. 07, s. 2022 
(the 2022 Revised Implementing Rules and Regulations of RA 8292, which 
amended CMO No. 03, s. 2001), the President of the duly registered or 
accredited faculty association of the College sits as a member of the Board 
of Trustees. 
2. The right to sit in the Board arises by operation of law from the faculty 
member's election and qualification as President of the faculty association, 
including the taking of the oath of office. It does not depend on any 
appointment or designation by the College President or by the Board of 
Trustees. Membership is coterminous with the term of office as President 
of the faculty association. 
3. Our records show that you took your oath as member of the Board of 
Trustees on October 1, 2024 and have sat as Faculty Trustee from 
September 25, 2024 to September 25, 2026. 
 
We note that the document you previously submitted to the evaluators was issued 
by the officers of the NBSCFAI. That document is properly understood as a 
certification of your election as Association President, not as an appointment. 
Matters on the conduct of the Association's election, under its Constitution and 
By-Laws, are best attested to by the Association itself. You may wish to submit its 
certificate of election together with the enclosed certification. 
 
In view of the foregoing, the enclosed Certification is issued to document the 
legal basis and effectivity period of your service as Faculty Trustee. A companion 
certification from the Board Secretary on your seating and attendance in the 
Board may also be requested from that Office. We further note that the evidence 
requirements for Faculty Trustee under the DBM-CHED reclassification 

 
guidelines include the annual report of the faculty association for the period 
claimed. 
 
Please be advised that this Certification is issued only to state facts and the 
governing legal provisions. The evaluation and crediting of your claim remain with 
the Institutional Evaluation Committee, in accordance with DBM-CHED Joint 
Circular No. 1, s. 2026. 
 
Thank you, and we wish you well in your application. 
 
 
 
Very truly yours, 
 
 
 
CHRISTIE JEAN VILLANUEVA–GANIERA, EdD, CESE  
SUC President I 
 
 
 
Encl.: Certification dated November 16, 2026  
 
 
Digitally signed by 
Ganiera Christie 
Jean Villanueva 
Date: 2026.11.17 
06:57:55 +08'00'

 
CERTIFICATION 
This is to certify that JULIUS GABINETE, DM, Instructor I, a permanent faculty 
member of Northern Bukidnon State College, is the President of the Northern Bukidnon 
State College Faculty Association, Inc. (NBSCFAI), as reported by the Association in its 
certificate of election dated September 25, 2024, and by virtue thereof sits as Faculty 
Trustee, member of the NBSC Board of Trustees. 
This further certifies that: 
1. The Faculty Trustee's membership in the Board of Trustees is conferred by Section 
6 of Republic Act No. 11284 (Charter of NBSC), in relation to Section 3(a)(vi) 
and 3(b) of Republic Act No. 8292 and Sections 6(g), 7, and 11 of CHED 
Memorandum Order No. 07, s. 2022. It arises automatically from election and 
qualification as President of the faculty association and is coterminous with that 
term. It is not conferred through an appointment or designation order issued by the 
College President or the Board of Trustees. 
2. Dr. Gabinete took his oath of office as member of the Board of Trustees on 
October 1, 2024 and has served as Faculty Trustee from September 25, 2024 to 
September 25, 2026, as shown by the records of the Board of Trustees. 
3. The position of Faculty Regent/Trustee is among the administrative designations 
enumerated in the DBM-CHED faculty reclassification guidelines (DBM-CHED 
JC No. 3, s. 2022, as enhanced by JC No. 1, s. 2026). 
This certification is issued upon the request of Dr. Gabinete in support of his application 
for faculty reclassification under DBM-CHED Joint Circular No. 1, s. 2026, and for no 
other purpose. The evaluation and crediting of the claim rest with the Institutional 
Evaluation Committee. 
Issued this 16th day of November 2026 at Northern Bukidnon State College, Kihare, 
Manolo Fortich, Bukidnon. 
 
 
CHRISTIE JEAN VILLANUEVA–GANIERA, EdD, CESE 
SUC President I 
 
Digitally signed by 
Ganiera Christie 
Jean Villanueva
